business_summary: Digital Realty Trust, Inc. develops and operates wholesale and colocation data centers for hyperscale customers, structured as a REIT and one of the largest independent data-center operators by footprint alongside Equinix. It sits on the hyperscale-datacenters link only.

exposure_summary.narrative: ABI Research's 2025 operator census identifies Digital Realty as one of the largest U.S. colocation data-center operators, the same direct, near-pure-play placement structure as Equinix: data-center wholesale and colocation is the whole business, not a segment.

revenue_cagr_3y.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/DLR.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Three-year compound annual revenue growth computed as (6112692000 / 4691834000) ** (1/3) - 1 from the companyfacts Revenues series, fiscal year ended 2022-12-31 to fiscal year ended 2025-12-31.

operating_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/DLR.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_margin.basis: OperatingIncomeLoss 658492000 divided by Revenues 6112692000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, both from companyfacts.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/DLR.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities 2412136000 divided by net income 1308589000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, both from companyfacts.

confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only. VERIFIED is a figure read directly off SEC companyfacts as reported. INFERRED is a figure computed from SEC companyfacts, with the derivation named in its basis. SPECULATIVE is reserved for the reverse-DCF solve, whose discount rate and terminal growth are assumed. NULL is a field looked for and not found or unusable without mixing reporting periods, never estimated.

notes: Profiles are medium-depth reusable research. This file carries no final verdict, no entry zone and no red team; those belong to the deep-dive stage.
